title: Dehiwala Traffic OIC reportedly leaves post over work pressure
byline: The Officer-in-Charge (OIC) of the Traffic Division of the Dehiwala Police Station has reportedly left his post and returned home, citing unbearable work-related pressure.

title: New York City imposes year-long AI ban for younger students
byline: New York City public schools will temporarily bar elementary and middle school students from using generative artificial intelligence tools during the upcoming school year, Mayor Zohran Mamdani said on Wednesday.

title: Australia, Singapore, France and U.S. assisted in investigation, says Deputy Solicitor General
byline: Parliamentarian Namal Rajapaksa, who was arrested by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption over allegations of accepting a Rs. 100 million bribe in connection with a transaction involving the purchase of Airbus aircraft, has been ordered to be remanded till September 18 by the Colombo Chief Magistrate Asanga S Bodaragama yesterday.

title: UN votes to adopt new map that makes our world look very different
byline: The United Nations General Assembly voted on Friday to adopt a new world map that reflects countries’ true relative sizes, after African nations urged the UN to right a centuries-old wrong.

title: Litro gas prices slashed
byline: The prices of Litro domestic LP gas cylinders have been reduced with effect from today (05), Litro Gas Lanka announced.

title: Australia blocks international students from enrolling in graduate diploma course
byline: Australia has moved to stop new international student enrolments in the Graduate Diploma of Management (Learning), citing concerns over visa misuse, high refusal rates and course non-completion.

title: Shooting in Boralesgamuwa leaves 74-year-old man dead
byline: A 74-year-old man was shot dead at his residence on Malani Bulathsinghala Mawatha in Boralesgamuwa a short while ago, police said.

title: No concerns raised over Iranian vessels anchored off Sri Lanka
byline: The Sri Lankan Government has received no formal request or message from Iran regarding its vessels that remained close to Sri Lanka’s territorial waters, Deputy Defence Minister Aruna Jayasekera told the Daily Mirror.

title: Malaysia declares emergency in Sarawak as haze from Indonesia worsens
byline: Country implements state of emergency in Sarawak’s Serian district after air pollution reaches ‘hazardous’ levels.

title: Tea and milk tea prices reduced by Rs. 5
byline: The All Ceylon Restaurant and Cafeteria Owners’ Association has decided to reduce the prices of plain tea and milk tea by Rs. 5, following the recent reduction in Litro gas prices.

title: Past wrongdoing will be treated equally: Govt
byline: In the wake of the latest arrests of MP Namal Rajapaksa and former Minister Johnston Fernando by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC), Deputy Minister of Public Security Sunil Watagala said that the Government’s position was that accountability for past wrongdoing should apply equally to everyone, regardless of political affiliation.

title: President moves to fast-track Lower Malwathu Oya Project
byline: President chairs discussion to fast-track Lower Malwathu Oya Reservoir Project

title: Malaysia declares emergency in Sarawak as haze from Indonesia worsens
byline: Country implements state of emergency in Sarawak’s Serian district after air pollution reaches ‘hazardous’ levels.

title: Navy rescues 11 stranded people off Thalaimannar
byline: The Sri Lanka Navy today rescued and provided urgent humanitarian assistance to 11 people stranded in the Thalaimannar area, including five children, during routine patrol operations.

title: Two youths drown in Nanu Oya canal
byline: Two youths drowned while bathing in the Nanu Oya canal in the Radella Glasgow Estate area, Nanu Oya, police said.

title: Alcohol, drugs completely banned at events using school logos
byline: The Education Ministry has announced a complete ban on the promotion and use of alcohol and drugs at any event organised using a school’s logo.

title: AI safety systems to be piloted on long-distance private buses
byline: A pilot project has been launched to introduce Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology to long-distance private buses, with the aim of enhancing the safety of both passengers and drivers.

title: House worth over Rs. 15 Mn frozen under Money Laundering Act
byline: The Illegal Assets Investigation Division has issued a freezing order on property valued at over Rs. 15 million, alleged to have been acquired through illegal means.

title: U.S. attacks 3 Iranian oil tankers after missiles target Navy warships
byline: U.S. forces struck three Iranian crude oil carriers Saturday after U.S. Central Command said the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps launched ballistic missiles toward two Navy warships in the region.

title: ‘I love these kinds of races’ – David on going from 17th to fourth in Monza Sprint
byline: Yevan David hailed his “incredible” drive from P17 to fourth place in the Monza Sprint, with the AIX Racing driver aiming to do even better in Sunday’s Feature Race.
